Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Gene Myers <myersgene@comcast.net>
Sent: Friday, December 4, 2015 11:53 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: A READER'S COMMENT 
 
ANTHONY: You don’t need to listen to me anymore, so consider this two cents from “a reader:”
Pelfrey, 31, posted a 4.26 ERA with a 1.47 WHIP in 30 starts this season with the Minnesota Twins. He struck out 4.7 batters per nine innings.

ERA and WHIP are vital stats, of course, but I also like to see W-L and quality starts. The win-loss record, while old-fashion, does tell me whether with his high ERA and WHIP he got support, and the quality starts tells me that whether he pitches well enough at times to win.
Also, on another note, Pelfrey isn’t a hard thrower, right? That’s kinda an anti-Dombrowski signing, right? J
Have fun at the winter meetings!
